capabilities.description: Free-form capability keys. The three routing booleans below are explicitly nullable: null means the vendor's own model docs do not state the answer and nobody verified it. The router treats null exactly like absent (fail-closed), so an honest unknown costs a routing candidate, while a guessed true would route traffic to a model that may not support the feature. Never write a guess here; write null. regional_processing_multiplier, inference_geo_us_multiplier and region_agnostic_pricing are NOT capability data — they decide what a request costs (the first two multiply this row's rates, the third decides whether this global row's price answers a regional lookup), so the immutable dated snapshot pins them alongside `pricing` and editing one is a price edit. NOTE: nothing in this repository validates catalog YAML against this schema; validate_catalog.py and the Go catalog tests are the enforced gates, and this file is the contract the published OSS mirror and community price PRs read. Keep all three in sync.
